slug: 2025-10-31 Cabo Verde launches national SOC and CSIRT

facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports Cabo Verde launched a CSIRT within the State's Private Technological Network (RTPE), described as a national cyber alert-and-response hub for public institutions and private organisations; no event date is given, so the publication date 2025-10-31 is used.

note: No incident handled, alert, critical infrastructure designation or figures stated.
